paite: Saul in Toupa nungzuite vau leh thah atup thu agen lailai man in siampu lianpen kiang ah ava hoh hi.
heading: Saul Pianthakna

paite: Damaskas a sinagog tengteng amite kiang a piak ding in lai angen a, hiai Lampi zui mi kuapeuh amuhleh, numei leh pasal leng, hen a Jerusalem a hon pitheihna ding in.
Huan apai lai in, Damaskas atun kuan in, thakhat in van a kipan vak akim ah ahong vak puap hi.
Huan lei ah apuk a, akiang ah, "Saul, Saul, bang achia nang hon sawi na hia?" chi in aw aza hi.
Huan ama'n, "Toupa, kua na hia?" achi hi. Toupa'n akiang ah, "Na sawi Jesu ka hi; kilhna sikzum na tot nang ding in ahaksa hi," achi hi.
Huan ling leh lamdang sa kawm in, "Toupa bang sem ding a hon deih na hiam?" achi hi. Toupa'n akiang ah, "Thou inla, khopi ah lut in, huchi in na hih ding hilh in na om ding hi," achi hi.
Atonpihte gen ding thei lou in adingh ua, aw zaw aza ua, himahleh kuamah amu kei uh.
Huan lei a kipan in Saul athou a; ahong hak a kuamah amutheita kei hi; huchi in akhut in akai ua, Damaskas ah apilut uhi.
Huan ni thum kho mu lou in a-om a, bangmah ne in adawn kei hi.
Huan Damaskas ah amin Ananias nungzui khat a-om hi. Toupa'n mengmu bang in akiang ah, "Ananias,” achi hi.
heading: Damaskas Khua Ah Saul

paite: Huan ama'n, "En in, Toupa, hiai ah ka om," achi hi. Toupa'n akiang ah, "Thou inla, Kongzing Tang achih uah hoh inla, Judas inn ah, Tarsas khomi, amin Saul kichi kankhia in. Ngai in, athum laitak ahi.
Ama'n mengmuhna in mi khat amin Ananias akiang ava lut a, amit hihvakna ding a atung akhut nga in amuta hi," achi hi.
Ananias in, "Toupa huai mi Jerusalem a na misiangthoute tung a atatsiat thu mi tampi kam ah ka za hi.
Huan hiai ah na min lou peuhmah hen ding in siampu liante a kipan thuneihna toh hong pai ahi," chi in adawng hi.
Himahleh Toupa'n akiang ah, "Hoh mai in; Zentelte, kumpipate leh Israel suante kiang a ka min polut ding a ka belseh ahi.
Ka min ziak in gimna bangchi a thupi ahia athuak ding akiang ah ka theisak ding," achi hi.

Huan Ananias ava hoh a, inn ah alut a, huan atung ah akhut anga a, "Unau Saul, na mitvakna ding leh Kha Siangthou dim a na omtheihna ding in, Toupa, na hong paina lampi a na kiang a kilak Jesu'n hon sawl ahi," achi hi.
Huan thakhat in amit a kipan lip bang aketa a, amit avak nawnta a; athou a, huan baptisma atangta hi.
Huan an ane a, ahalhta hi. Huan Damaskas a nungzui omte kiang ah ni bangzah hiam ataam hi.
Huan Sinagog ah, "Jesu, Pathian Tapa" ahihdan thu atangkoupih zui ngal hi.
heading: Paul In Damaskas Ah Thu Agen

paite: Huan athu zate tengteng in lamdang asa ua, “Hiai mipa Jerusalem a hiai minloute sawi zelpa ahi kei a hia? Huai mite siampu liante kiang a hensa a piak sawm a hong hohpa hilou hia?" achi uhi.
Saul bel ahong hattuam a, huai mi Khrist ahi taktak chih ahilhchian a, Damaskas a Juda omte gen ding bei in akoih hilhial hi.
Huan ni sawttak nung in Saul that ding in Judate akihou uhi.
Himahleh ama'n athiltup uh ana thei hi. Huan amah thah tum in kulh kong teng ah sun leh zan in atang uhi.
Himahleh anungzuite'n zan in api ua, kulh tohlet ah bawm in akhaikheta uhi.
Huan Jerusalem a Saul atuntak in nungzuite kithuahpih atum a; amau bel avek un amah akihta ua, nungzui ahih sam agingta kei uhi.
heading: Jerusalem Leh Tarsas Khua Ah Saul

paite: Barnabas in amah api a, sawltakte kiang ah apaipih a, lampi a Toupa amuh a, ahoupihdan bang, Damaskas a Jesu min a hangtak a thu ahilhdan khawng leng akiang uah agenta hi.
Huchi in Jerusalem ah Saul tuh akiang uah lut zel pawt zel in a-omta a, Toupa min in hangsantak in thu agen zel hi.
Huan Grik pau zang Judate kiang ah thu agen a, asel a; amau bel amah hihlup atum uhi.
Huan unaute'n huai atheihtak un, Kaisaria ah apisuk ua, Tarsas ah asawlmangta uhi.
Huchi in saptuamte Judia, Galili leh Samaria gam kimvel ah akip deuhdeuh ua, muangtak in a-omta ua; huan Toupa laudan siam kawm in, Kha Siangthou khamuan in a-om ua, ahong pung deuhdeuh uhi.
Huan Peter in kho kim atot vialvial kawm in, Lidda a Mi Siangthou omte kiang ah leng ahohsuk hi.
heading: Lidda Khua A Peters In Ahihdamna

paite: Huai ah mi khat amin Ainias, azawt ziak a kum giat lupna a lumden amu hi.
Huan Peter in akiang ah, "Ainias aw, Jesu Khrist in ahon hihdam, thou inla, na awngphah zial in,” achi hi. Huchi in athou pahta hi.
Huan Lidda khua leh Sharon phai a omte tengteng in Ainias amu ua, Toupa lam anga duam uhi.
Huan Joppa ah amin Tabitha nungzui khat a-om a, Tabitha minkhiakna tuh Dorkas ahi, huai numei in thil hihhoih leh thilpiak ahau mahmah hi.
heading: Dorka

paite: Huai lai in, achi ana a, asi hi; huchi in asilsiang ua, indan tungnung ah asial uhi.
Huan Lidda khua tuh Joppa kho kiang ahih ziak in, nungzuite'n Peter huai ah a-om chih aza ua, "Sawt hal lou in ka kiang uah hong pai in," chi a va thum ding in akiang ah mi nih asawl uhi.
Huan Peter athou a akiang uah apaita hi. Huan atuntak in indan tungnung ah api ua; meithai tengteng dingh in, akiang ua Dorkas a-om lai a apuanak bawlte, apuan bawlte lak kawm in akap chiat uhi.
Himahleh Peter in avek un apawtsak a, akhukdin a, athumta hi; huan luanglam anga a, "Tabitha, thou in," achi hi. Huchi in amit ahong hak a, Peter amuhtak in atutou hi.
Huan Peter in akhut apia a, akaithou hi, misiangthoute leh meithaite asam a, hingdam in apeta hi.
Huan huai Joppa kho tengteng in athei vek ua; mi tampi in Toupa agingta uhi.
Huan Joppa ah savunbawlpa Simon inn ah ni tampitak Peter ataam nilouh hi.
